question.html:
A conducting wire is moving in a uniform magnetic field. Consider the following:

I. The magnitude of the magnetic field strength.

II. The length of the wire.

III. The speed at which the wire is moving. 

The induced emf in the wire is proportional to:

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
